youtube.title: Quit Notice in Rivers vs Lagos: The Anniversary Trap (Deep-Dive 8)
youtube.description:
Did your landlord serve a quit notice that ends mid-month or right after rent expired? In Rivers State, section 7 makes it mandatory that notices terminate on the eve of the tenancy anniversary, while Lagos section 13(4) has a different rule. Learn how the notice ladder works, why expiry of rent does not end tenancy, and how to verify statutory notices in two minutes on your phone.

Generate your standard tenancy documents at https://docoga.com.ng

General information, not legal advice.

claims.text: In Rivers State under section 7 of the Recovery of Premises Law, a notice to quit must terminate on the eve of the anniversary of the current term.
Section 13 subsection 4 of the Lagos Tenancy Law 2011 is the exception, where three- and six-month notices need not end on the anniversary and may end on or after the date the tenancy expires.
For a yearly tenancy in Rivers that began on 1 January 2025, a valid six-month quit notice must expire on 31 December 2025, which is the eve of the anniversary.
In Rivers under section 6 subsection 1 d, a yearly tenant is entitled to six months notice.
Under section 6 subsection 2 in Rivers, the nature of a tenancy is determined, absent contrary evidence, by reference to the mode of payment and demand for rent.
In Rivers, the expiry of rent does not end the tenancy, and a tenancy is determined by a valid notice or effluxion of a fixed term.
After the quit notice expires in Rivers, the landlord must serve a further written notice of the owner intention to apply to court to recover possession of not less than seven clear days.
For the seven clear days notice, the day of service is excluded and the day of expiry included.
Under section 5 in Rivers, a notice to quit is given in Form B when signed by the landlord himself, Form C when signed by an agent or solicitor, and the seven-day notice under section 8 is Form E.
The Court of Appeal in Anyaehie v Ongolo held on sections 5 to 7 of the Rivers Law that a notice to quit is a process of court addressed to a known tenant and not a letter.
Under section 6 subsection 1 a in Rivers, a tenant at will or weekly tenant receives one week notice.
Under section 29 in Rivers, a tenant includes any person occupying premises whether on payment of rent or otherwise, but not a person occupying under a bona fide claim of ownership.
Under section 75 subsection 1 of the Landlord and Tenant Law in Rivers, rent is payable in arrears unless the parties agree otherwise.
In Rivers, a defect in the issue, content or service of a notice vitiates the whole proceeding.
The date of service is the material date, not the date written on the notice.
Under sections 20 to 22 in Rivers, an occupier whose tenancy has ended can be put out only in pursuance of a court order obtained after the Law notices.

In Lagos under section 13 subsection 5, a fixed-term tenancy needs no quit notice at all once it determines by effluxion of time, requiring only a seven-day notice of intention to recover possession in Form TL5.

Under section 44 subsection 1 of the Lagos Tenancy Law 2011, demolishing, altering or modifying a building to eject a tenant without court approval is an offence punishable by 250,000 naira fine or 6 months imprisonment.
A landlord who acts as if running out of rent automatically ejects you is acting unlawfully.
This seven-day notice cannot be issued while the quit notice is still running. It can only be served after the quit notice has completely expired.
A landlord who takes the law into his own hands commits an actionable wrong that sounds in damages.
